import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Number of species: {train_df['species'].nunique()}")

# Get feature columns (all numeric except id and species)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df["species"].values.astype(str).tolist()
ids_train = train_df["id"].values

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
ids_test = test_df["id"].values

# Create holdout validation split (20% for validation) - IMPORTANT: Never use full data for final model
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, random_state=42, stratify=y_train, test_size=0.2
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_tr)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")

# Get all species names from sample submission
all_species = list(sample_submission.columns[1:])
print(f"All species: {len(all_species)}")

# Train Gradient Boosting Classifier
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
)

print("Training model...")
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Evaluate on holdout validation set (never seen during training)
val_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Ensure probabilities are valid range and sum to 1
val_predictions_clipped = np.clip(val_predictions, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_predictions_summed = val_predictions_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
val_predictions_normalized = val_predictions_clipped / val_predictions_summed

validation_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_predictions_normalized)
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {validation_logloss:.6f}")

# Save predictions to submission
test_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test)
test_predictions_clipped = np.clip(test_predictions, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_predictions_summed = test_predictions_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_predictions_normalized = test_predictions_clipped / test_predictions_summed

submission_dict = {"id": ids_test}
for i, species in enumerate(all_species):
    submission_dict[species] = test_predictions_normalized[:, i]

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_dict)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Saved submission with {len(submission_df)} rows to ./submission/submission.csv")

print("\nTop 5 species per row (top classes):")
for i, (_, row) in enumerate(submission_df.head(5).iterrows()):
    nonzero_cols = row[row > 0]
    print(f"ID {row['id']}: {nonzero_cols.to_dict()}")

print("\n=== COMPLETE ===")
